import unittest


def unique_digits(x):
    
    odd_digit_elements = []
    for i in x:
        if all (int(c) % 2 == 1 for c in str(i)):
            odd_digit_elements.append(i)
    return sorted(odd_digit_elements)

# Unit test for function unique_digits
def test_unique_digits():
    # Basic mixed case
    assert unique_digits([15, 33, 1422, 1]) == [1, 15, 33]
    # All digits odd, unsorted input
    assert unique_digits([311, 13, 111]) == [111, 311, 13] or unique_digits([311, 13, 111]) == [13, 111, 311]
    # Empty list
    assert unique_digits([]) == []
    # No elements with all odd digits
    assert unique_digits([2, 4, 6, 8]) == []
    # Single element with all odd digits
    assert unique_digits([135]) == [135]
    # Single element with an even digit
    assert unique_digits([1357]) == [1357]
    # Contains zero (even digit)
    assert unique_digits([101, 111]) == [111]
    # Duplicates preserved
    assert unique_digits([11, 11, 33]) == [11, 11, 33]
    # Single-digit numbers
    assert unique_digits([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]) == [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]
    # Result is sorted regardless of input order
    assert unique_digits([9, 7, 5, 3, 1]) == [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]
    # Larger numbers with all odd digits
    assert unique_digits([111, 133, 155, 122]) == [111, 133, 155]
    # Mixed with multi-digit and single-digit
    assert unique_digits([12, 31, 45, 57, 99]) == [31, 57, 99]
    print("All tests passed!")


class TestUniqueDigits(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_basic(self):
        self.assertEqual(unique_digits([15, 33, 1422, 1]), [1, 15, 33])

    def test_empty(self):
        self.assertEqual(unique_digits([]), [])

    def test_no_odd_digits(self):
        self.assertEqual(unique_digits([2, 4, 6, 8]), [])

    def test_all_odd(self):
        self.assertEqual(unique_digits([9, 7, 5, 3, 1]), [1, 3, 5, 7, 9])

    def test_zero_is_even(self):
        self.assertEqual(unique_digits([101, 111]), [111])

    def test_duplicates(self):
        self.assertEqual(unique_digits([11, 11, 33]), [11, 11, 33])

    def test_sorted_output(self):
        self.assertEqual(unique_digits([99, 13, 5]), [5, 13, 99])

    def test_single_element(self):
        self.assertEqual(unique_digits([13579]), [13579])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_unique_digits()
    unittest.main()
